thread:
elaine: Quick thread to finalize the tri-mode hero copy and final lead routing rules before content freeze. Need compact hero lines, subhead, CTAs, and exact form mapping. Design needs locked content by tonight.

ana: I'll keep three variants, outcome-led, 6 words max. New drafts:
Hosted: "Fast to pilot, production-ready at scale"
Dedicated: "Reserved capacity with SLA-backed latency"
Private: "Air-gapped deployments with enterprise audit trails"

mike: Good. Subheads to pair (<=12 words):
Hosted: "Start with a simple API, grow predictably without rework"
Dedicated: "Predictable throughput for business-critical inference workloads"
Private: "VPC and on-prem installs with granular controls and logs"

rachel: CTA language suggestions: Hosted primary: "Start a free trial" secondary: "Join launch webinar". Dedicated primary: "Request capacity plan" secondary: "Join launch webinar". Private primary: "Contact enterprise sales" secondary: "Join launch webinar".

elaine: Routing rules proposal: Hosted -> Product self-serve queue. Dedicated & Private -> Enterprise SDR funnel. Webinar signups -> Education nurture sequence. But we should capture source_page + intent flags.

luis: Implementation snippet for form hidden inputs:
<form>
  <input type="hidden" name="lead_channel" value="web">
  <input type="hidden" name="lead_route" value="selfserve|enterprise|webinar">
  <input type="hidden" name="source_page" value="hosted|dedicated|private">
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="tri_mode_launch_q4">
</form>
And GTM events: `tri_mode_cta` (label=page_type), `tri_mode_submit` (label=lead_route). I'll push the tags to /product-analytics and include mapping docs.

jamal: Add an override checkbox: "Talk to sales" sets `lead_route=enterprise` and `lead_owner=SDR`. Legal note: on Private page use "designed for regulated environments" rather than implying certifications. I'll confirm wording with legal.

mike: For the webinar CTAs, contextual microcopy: Hosted: "Watch: quickstart + cost optimization"; Dedicated: "Watch: capacity planning & SLAs"; Private: "Watch: secure deployment patterns". Keep 1-line previews next to CTA.

rachel: Also add a small migration hint on each page: "Move from Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private as you scale or need isolation." Keep it subtle and linked to a migration guide.

elaine: Webinar structure for comms: 20-minute demo (hosted quickstart + Dedicated config + Private checklist), 10-minute benchmarks & methodology (call out dataset, avg seq len, model family; include "results will vary by workload"), 20-minute customer stories + live Q&A. We want the webinar registration page and nurture emails ready for launch.

luis: I'll instrument form to capture `lead_ts` and `lead_id` (uuid) and include `lead_owner_tag` when routed to SDR. Will also implement a short debounce to avoid duplicates.

elaine: Deliverables + deadlines: Ana final copy by 5:00pm PT, Luis tracking + GTM by 4:30pm PT, Rachel to update CTA microcopy and migration link by 6:00pm PT, Jamal to confirm legal wording for Private by EOD, Mike will draft the launch post by tomorrow 9:00am. Design lock at 18:00 UTC (content freeze).

deploy-bot: Reminder: content freeze for landing pages at 2023-11-15T18:00:00Z.

mike: Thanks team. We'll keep this as the canonical thread for hero copy, CTA text and lead routing mapping. Ping here with any edits.
